jsonld.description: California voters have rejected a tax on the net worth of billionaires following a contentious and expensive ballot fight. The measure would have imposed a one-time 5% tax on the wealth of Californians whose net worth exceeds $1 billion. It would have been the first tax of its kind in the nation. It was opposed by Democratic Gov. Gavin Newsom and some of California’s wealthiest residents. Newsom argued the tax would have prompted ultrawealthy taxpayers to leave the state. Backers of the measure wanted to raise money to backfill federal funding cuts to healthcare.
